- It tests a hypothesis with strong prior motivation (image-only resnet50 was weak, a stronger encoder might help more in multimodal context)
- If it works, it could push accuracy higher
- If it doesn't, we still have 1 experiment left to try something else
- It's the most logical exploitation of the current best configuration
